s_en: TSMC's equipment requirements have nearly doubled in just eight months as AI demand drives an unprecedented fab expansion, yet its 2026 CapEx budget has risen by only around 15%.
s_zh: TSMC的裝置需求在短短的8個月內幾乎翻了一番,因為AI的需求驅動著前所未有的晶片製造廠擴張,然而其2026 CapEx的預算卻只增長了15%左右.

s_ja: TSMCの機器の要件は、AIの需要が未曾有のチップ製造工場の拡張を駆動するためわずか8ヶ月でほぼ2倍になりましたが、その2026 CapExの予算は、約15%増加しました。
s_ko: TSMC의 장비 요구 사항은 AI 수요로 불과 8 개월 만에 거의 두 배가 비례없는 칩 제작 공장 확장을 구동하지만 2026 CapEx 예산은 약 15 %로 상승했습니다.

s_en: Sam Altman says that a single almond uses up more water than 38,000 ChatGPT queries. He said that the concerns of people about data centers using up so much water are nothing but a "robust meme," and that the claim doesn't hold up to any scrutiny.
